repos.name: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
repos.description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent LLM framework specifically designed for financial trading and market analysis.
bullets: Built on a multi-agent architecture where specialized LLM agents handle data analysis, strategy formulation, and risk management.
Integrates with financial data APIs to provide real-time market context for decision-making.
Designed for quantitative finance professionals to automate trading workflows using agentic reasoning.
Supports backtesting and simulation environments to validate agent performance before deployment.

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: OpenAI-compatible proxy that stacks the free tiers of 28 LLM providers (~4B tokens/month) behind one /v1 endpoint — plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Smart routing, automatic failover, encrypted keys. Personal experimentation only.
repos.one_liner: An OpenAI-compatible proxy that aggregates free tiers from 28 LLM providers into a single unified endpoint.
bullets: Implements smart routing and automatic failover across multiple LLM providers to ensure high availability.
Provides a standard /v1 API interface, making it a drop-in replacement for existing OpenAI-based applications.
Optimizes infrastructure costs by leveraging free-tier token allowances across a massive provider network.
Ideal for developers building high-volume AI applications who need to minimize latency and API expenses.

repos.name: ApodexAI/FrontierAgent
repos.description: 🧩 FrontierAgent, our agent framework, open-sourced alongside it — native command-line TUI, ReAct and Agent Team modes, one command on macOS and Linux, no preinstall, no hard Docker dependency.
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, zero-dependency agent framework featuring a native TUI and support for ReAct and multi-agent team modes.
bullets: Features a native command-line TUI for real-time interaction and monitoring of agentic workflows.
Supports both ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) and collaborative Agent Team modes for complex task execution.
Designed for portability with no hard Docker dependency and a 'one-command' installation process.
Focuses on developer productivity by streamlining the deployment of autonomous agents in local environments.

repos.name: htdt/godogen
repos.description: Autonomous game development for Godot, Bevy, and Babylon.js with Claude Code and Codex
repos.one_liner: An autonomous development framework for game engines like Godot, Bevy, and Babylon.js using LLM-driven code generation.
bullets: Leverages Claude Code and Codex to automate the generation of game logic and scene structures.
Provides a bridge between high-level natural language prompts and low-level engine-specific APIs.
Reduces boilerplate in game development by automating repetitive coding tasks across multiple engine architectures.
Useful for rapid prototyping and building complex game systems through agentic assistance.

repos.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
repos.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repos.one_liner: A curated CLAUDE.md configuration file optimized to improve LLM coding performance based on Andrej Karpathy's engineering insights.
bullets: Systematizes best practices for LLM-assisted coding by codifying common pitfalls and effective patterns.
Acts as a 'system prompt' enhancement to force better reasoning and code structure from AI coding assistants.
Directly improves the quality of generated code, documentation, and architectural decisions in dev workflows.
Essential for software engineers looking to maximize the reliability and accuracy of their AI-driven development tools.
